metrics.title: Name response within 2 seconds
metrics.observableCriteria: Dog orients to handler within 2 seconds of name spoken once at conversational volume.

metrics.title: Recall on long line — 5 metres
metrics.observableCriteria: Single recall cue; dog returns to within arm's reach on 5m long line in low distraction.

metrics.title: Recall on long line — 10 metres
metrics.observableCriteria: Single recall cue; reliable on 10m long line with mild distraction.

metrics.title: Loose lead — 10 consecutive steps
metrics.observableCriteria: Ten consecutive steps with slack lead without owner stopping.

metrics.title: Off-lead freedom (not auto-unlocked)
metrics.observableCriteria: App must not promote off-lead in public until tier 2 recall met AND owner confirms secure area or professional sign-off.
